summary.decisions: One stable key 'petal_panic_store' holding {progress, settings, saveMeta}; in-memory cache as source of truth with every mutation persisting the whole document atomically; normalize() tolerates missing/mistyped fields on load; storage injected lazily via globalThis.localStorage with setStorage hook for tests (mirrors input.js createInput pattern).
summary.tradeoffs: updateProgress mutator receives the full store document (store.progress.completedAreas etc.) rather than the progress section directly — matches plan snippet style where saveMeta is set as store.saveMeta; callers must use store.progress.* for progress fields.
summary.done: Added petal-panic/js/systems/progressStore.js: single localStorage JSON document (key 'petal_panic_store') with progress/settings/saveMeta sections, safe defaults (DEFAULT_PROGRESS v1, DEFAULT_SETTINGS), and APIs loadStore/saveStore/updateProgress/updateSettings/markMediaUnlocked/hasSave/clearRunSave/resetStore plus setStorage/_resetCache test hooks. Added node:test suite js/test/progressStore.test.js (10 tests) covering empty/invalid storage, atomic mutate+persist, reload survival, hasSave semantics, storage-denied fallback.
summary.lessons_learned: Plan snippet's updateProgress example writes store.completedAreas directly but also store.saveMeta at top level — resolved by making the mutator receive the full document so both styles work consistently (saveMeta top-level, progress nested under store.progress).

summary.tradeoffs: None — state machine only, no screen wiring yet (later tasks). progressStore not needed at this layer since routing is pure state.
summary.done: Added MENU(10), OPTIONS(11), LEVEL_SELECT(12), BOSS_RUSH(13), MEDIA(14) states to petal-panic/js/core/state.js (S + STATE_NAMES) and extended TRANSITIONS: HOME→MENU; MENU→SELECT/PLAY/LEVEL_SELECT/BOSS_RUSH/MEDIA/REMAP/OPTIONS; PAUSE gains MENU+OPTIONS; OPTIONS→MENU|PAUSE; LEVEL_SELECT/BOSS_RUSH→MENU|PLAY|AREA_ENTRY; MEDIA→MENU; REMAP also returns to MENU. Added node:test suite petal-panic/js/test/stateMenu.test.js covering all acceptance criteria plus negative cases.
summary.decisions: Kept the single centralized TRANSITIONS map rather than per-state handlers; added S.MENU to REMAP's return set so Controls opened from the hub can go back there; OPTIONS returns to both MENU and PAUSE to serve as the shared options screen.
summary.lessons_learned: state.js is importable headless with plain node ESM — no DOM stubs needed for transition tests.

summary.done: Added canvas-drawn Menu hub screen to petal-panic/js/ui/screens.js: eight options (New Game, Continue/No Save, Level Select, Boss Rush, Media, Controls, Options, Credits) with the pause-style centered list, pink focus pill, and keycap nav bar; Continue label/enabled driven live by progressStore.hasSave(); up/down wrap and skip disabled entries; confirm routes New Game→SELECT, Continue→AREA_ENTRY (§2.3 owns resume), Level Select/Boss Rush/Media/OPTIONS/Controls→REMAP per the 2.1 transition map; back returns HOME. Wired MENU into drawScreen + screenOnAction dispatch, screenReset (Menu.reset), and render.js full-screen skip list. Fixed deferred 2.1 item: remapParent now resolves from {HOME, PAUSE, MENU} so REMAP opened from MENU returns to MENU. Added node:test suite js/test/menuScreen.test.js (9 tests).
summary.decisions: Reused Pause's exact ergonomics pattern (roundRect focus pill, ▸ prefix, drawNavBar/navHintEntries select_layout chips) rather than a new style; Menu.options() is a single source of truth shared by draw/onAction/focus-skip so enabled state can never diverge; wrote test saves via loadStore().saveMeta + saveStore (documented API) because updateProgress mutates only the progress section and cannot set top-level saveMeta.
summary.lessons_learned: updateProgress's mutator receives store.progress, not the full document — setting store.saveMeta inside it silently lands under progress.saveMeta and hasSave() stays false (the store's own test suite uses loadStore().saveMeta = ... for this reason). Also note run-all baseline on clean tree: 5 pre-existing failures (bombGameplay/dustCloud/shockwave + pickerRide/takeoffPicker) identical before and after this change.
summary.tradeoffs: Continue confirms to AREA_ENTRY without saveMeta restore logic — that flow is owned by task 2.3; the transition edge already exists from 2.1. Credits confirm is a no-op until its presentation lands in a later task.

summary.lessons_learned: headless-smoke.mjs fails on a clean tree too (composeArea: no compatible macros — macro loading in node env), pre-existing and unrelated. progressStore.saveMeta must be written at document top level, never inside updateProgress.
summary.done: Added three lifecycle ops in petal-panic/js/systems/lifecycle.js: newGameFromMenu() (clearRunSave + SELECT), continueFromMenu(hero) (restore currentLevel/currentArea from loadStore().saveMeta, open AREA_ENTRY via showAreaEntry), saveCurrentRun(hero) (writes top-level saveMeta {level, area, score via calculateScore(traceStats.total), timestamp} through loadStore/saveStore). Wired Menu hub in screens.js: New Game action now calls newGameFromMenu(); Continue option switched from go:S.AREA_ENTRY to action:'continue' calling continueFromMenu(_menuHero); added setMenuHero/getMenuHero registration. update.js registers the live hero via setHeroRef (boot + every hero swap). New test file js/test/menuRunFlow.test.js (8 tests) covers all four acceptance bullets incl. storage round-trip.
summary.decisions: Continue routing moved from option-level 'go' data to an action handler so the saveMeta restore happens before the transition; hero passed via setMenuHero registration (update.js owns the live hero ref) rather than window globals. Save & Quit write side exposed as saveCurrentRun() for task 4.2 to call; the PAUSE→MENU transition stays with 4.2.
summary.tradeoffs: continueFromMenu tolerates a null hero (bare-test path) by presenting the entry screen with the saved level/area and starting lives; real gameplay always has the registered live hero. saveCurrentRun sets store.saveMeta directly on the loaded document + saveStore (not updateProgress) since saveMeta is top-level per task 1.1.

4.2.name: Pause menu Save and Quit integration
